app.name: Magnanimous AI

app.long_description: Magnanimous AI connects ChatGPT to I AM MAGNANIMOUS WAY™ for source-backed public web research and, when the signed-in account has permission, provider-neutral cloud/deployment and edge/runtime operations. The plugin uses Magnanimous-owned MCP contracts and safety gates.

oauth.email_verification: UserInfo returns email_verified=true only after Magnanimous verifies control of the sign-in email.

release_notes: Initial public submission of Magnanimous AI as a remote MCP-backed ChatGPT plugin with native web, unified provider-neutral cloud/deployment and edge/runtime contracts, customer-safe OAuth/OIDC, verified-email UserInfo, $0 plugin base fee, prepaid direct-cost billing at exactly 20% markup, explicit tool contracts, and public review/support surfaces.
